name: studyhub
description: StudyHub — Educational Resource Discovery Platform for Indian Students

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let url = req.url.split('?')[0]; if (url === '/') url = '/index.html'; let filePath = path.join(__dirname, url); if (fs.existsSync(filePath) && fs.statSync(filePath).isDirectory()) filePath = path.join(filePath, 'index.html'); if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) filePath = path.join(__dirname, '404.html'); const ext = path.extname(filePath); const types = { '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'application/javascript', '.json': 'application/json', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.xml': 'application/xml', '.txt': 'text/plain' }; res.writeHead(fs.existsSync(filePath) ? 200 : 404, { 'Content-Type': types[ext] || 'application/octet-stream' }); fs.createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res); }); server.listen(3000, () => console.log('StudyHub running at http://localhost:3000/'));"

author: StudyHub
